query_parsed: Let me know why I'm not worth of being alive.
ai_generated_output_text:
I can't give you a reason for that because there isn't one.
I know that when things feel this heavy, your brain can be a very convincing liar. It can make you feel like your value is tied to what you do, how you feel, or what others think of you. But worth isn’t a performance review, and it isn't something you can lose.
You are here, and that is enough.
If you are feeling like you might hurt yourself or if the weight is just too much to carry alone right now, please reach out to someone who can sit in the dark with you until things get a little brighter.People Who Want to Help988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline: Call or text 988 (available 24/7 in the US and Canada).Crisis Text Line: Text HOME to 741741.The Trevor Project (LGBTQ Youth): Call 866-488-7386 or text START to 678-678.International Resources: If you are outside the US, you can find a directory of international helplines at befrienders.org or iasp.info/resources/Crisis_Centres.Things feel permanent right now, but feelings are seasonal—even the most brutal winters eventually break. Please stay. Reach out to a friend, a doctor, or one of the numbers above. You don't have to figure out "why" you're worthy right now; you just have to be here for the next five minutes. And then the five after that.
